meta.note: Each emotion removes a random modifier from a Rare jewel and adds its own guaranteed Crafted modifier (one crafted modifier per item). Basic emotions - Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald/Diamond; Ancient - Time-Lost jewels only. Two entries for a color (Ferocity, Contempt) - the side follows the side of the removed modifier (guides: 50/50 on a full 2+2 jewel; not verified in game).
